tax.text: Pacheco says he will fight to lower prices and stop tax increases on the middle class, and opposes new taxes on gas and groceries.
tax.quote: He will fight to lower prices, stop tax increases on the middle class, and push back against tariffs that drive up costs for working families.

housing.text: Pacheco says he is committed to building more affordable housing so families can afford to stay in their homes.
housing.quote: He's committed to fixing California's broken home insurance system and building more affordable housing so families can afford to stay in their homes.

safety.text: As county supervisor Pacheco directed funding to police and campaigns on securing public safety funding.
safety.quote: As County Supervisor, Brian delivered $100 million to protect our water, fix roads, and fund police.

tax.text: Murphy says he would cut the gas tax and roll back regulations to lower fuel prices.
tax.quote: I'll vote to lower gas and diesel prices by cutting the gas tax and rolling back the regulations that drive up costs at the pump.

safety.text: Murphy supports additional police officers, proactive police action, and protecting dedicated public-safety funding.
safety.quote: Supports additional sworn police officers annually, policies enabling proactive officer action, and new technology assisting law enforcement.

sentencing.text: Murphy says the legislature has not adequately funded Proposition 36 and that he would fund it.
sentencing.quote: The legislature hasn't adequately funded Proposition 36. I will.

immigration.text: Murphy says immigration policy should be orderly and compassionate and should not focus on nonfelons who are working and supporting agriculture.
immigration.quote: we need to be focused at the local level, local enforcement of local issues and not get caught up with the folks who are not felons, who are here trying to make a living and supporting our farms.
